timeline.summary: UPL announced further investment of ~USD 86.7 Mn in associate Sinova Inovacoes Agricolas S.A., increasing its stake to 55.81%.
UPL scheduled its board meeting for FY26 financial results and Capital Markets Day for May 11, 2026.
UPL reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹51,839 Cr and PAT of ₹2,220 Cr, recommending a dividend of ₹6 per share.
UPL reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹18,335 Cr and FY26 revenue of ₹51,839 Cr with significant debt reduction.
UPL published the audio/video recording link for its Capital Markets Day held on May 11, 2026.
UPL announced that its step-down subsidiary Advanta Seed International acquired newly incorporated Cayman Islands entity Advanta Investment Limited for USD 1.
UPL Limited will hold an earnings call for Q2 and H1 FY27 on Monday, November 2, 2026 at 16:00 hrs IST.
